quest.title: Portended Fate
quest.description: The previous events might have been mysterious, but miraculous. Caribert's consciousness has returned, and his mind is whole again. However, might this achievement bear a price yet unknown...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x775, Primogem x60, Mora x31175, Guide to Admonition x2, Guide to Ingenuity x2, Guide to Praxis x2, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: No, impossible... What happened?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: The hilichurl worshipers have disappeared, too...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Was it all an illusion?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: That's true... Yes, it can't have been an illusion. I still feel that awesome and wondrous power flowing through my mind and body...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: It was neither illusion, nor coincidence, and certainly no dream! It was a wonder... yes, a divine wonder.

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: ...Let's go, Traveler. There is surely a reason for its disappearance... And I do believe that some day in the future, we shall see it again.

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Could he really have been a "Sinner," and not a god...?

choices.text: We couldn't have both seen the exact same illusion.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take Eide, who seems to be in a trance, back to the small house...

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Caribert? Where has he gone!?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Oh no, no, no... Maybe someone else came by and found him?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: No, no, it can't have been that. There's no sign of a break-in, and no sign of anyone having been here...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: This does not bode well. What if he's spotted by a Forest Ranger? Or an adventurer? In his current state, they'd...

choices.text: Then we have to find him first...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Wait a minute... This isn't how we left it...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Oh no, did he...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: The mirror... It's broken...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hmm? But... hasn't the mirror been broken this whole time?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What does the broken mirror mean?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: He must've taken his mask off... and seen what he looks like beneath it...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Ugh, if he'd just done as he was told... We have to find him!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: It's his scarf... he dropped it.

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Looks like we're going the right way. Come on.

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Caribert!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We found him!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Caribert, stop! It's me! It's Papa!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Whatever you saw, it was... it was all a trick! An illusion!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: I told you, we're in a fairytale world now, nothing here is real... Please, Caribert, come back... it's time to go back!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Caribert?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: How could this happen? He regained his mind... He must be able to hear me, surely?

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Come, Caribert, we have to go home now... Papa's here to take you home, alright?

choices.text: Hold on, something's not right with him...
What has that strange power done to him?

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Curses... Forest Rangers.

dialogues.speaker: Forest Ranger
dialogues.text: Hey! Who are you? We haven't seen you around here before. What's your business here?

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Have you seen a hilichurl? A hilichurl should have come past this way... have you seen it?

dialogues.speaker: Forest Ranger
dialogues.text: I asked you first... Don't make this more difficult than it needs to be!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: I said... have you seen... a HILICHURL!!!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eide...

dialogues.speaker: Forest Ranger
dialogues.text: Hey, whoa... Look, Sir, there's no need to get so worked up...

dialogues.speaker: Forest Ranger
dialogues.text: There are hilichurls everywhere, what's the big deal? We see plenty of them out here...

dialogues.speaker: Ranger Guard
dialogues.text: Exactly. Matter of fact, we just took out a few of them back there. Those dumb boneheads...

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: You... you...!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Forest Ranger scum! You spawn of The Seven are all the same! I'll have your heads if you so much as laid a finger on Caribert!

dialogues.speaker: Forest Ranger
dialogues.text: You...! You're raving mad! You've got some gall, coming here to our nation, insulting the Forest Rangers!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Curse you all, Forest Rangers...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Both sides calm down for now, thanks to your urging...

response.speaker: Ranger Guard
response.text: I don't get it. Why make such a huge fuss over a few hilichurls...? It makes no sense...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: You...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: He'd only just regained his mind. How could you do this to him...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: So tell me, Forest Rangers... Did you really spare none of them? Did you really take out every last hilichurl you saw?

response.speaker: Ranger Guard
response.text: Geez, you're really not gonna let this go... Fine, you weirdo. If you must know, I happened to cross paths with a solitary hilichurl when I left the team to, uh... use the toilet.

response.speaker: Ranger Guard
response.text: I was frightened at first, but it didn't seem to have any interest in me at all. It was just bumbling along, in... that direction. So I left it alone.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's still hope!

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Yes! Wonderful... Wonderful. Let's go! We have to find him!

response.speaker: Forest Ranger
response.text: Wait, you're leaving? Not even a "Thanks for the info, goodbye"?

choices.text: Stop. Or the Forest Rangers and I will have to make you.

talks.objective: Use the clue to continue searching for Caribert

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: ...Haha, I see, I understand now...

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Finally, it all makes sense...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What happened... did I faint? I remember Caribert taking his mask off, but then...)

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Aha, Traveler, you're awake... Finally, we can rejoice together!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Wait, no... Why am I still calling you "Traveler"? I have known your true identity for some time now.

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Hehehe... I suspected it was you from the beginning! I had to talk to you to be sure.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But I've never met you...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: Oh, of course you haven't. With your status? You can hardly be expected to know all of us.

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: In any case... I've been using a fake name this entire time. "Eide" is the name of a servant I once had...

response.speaker: Eide
response.text: My real name is Chlothar...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: ...Chlothar Alberich.

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: You saw it too, didn't you? Unmistakable... The power inside Caribert and the power of the one you call a "Sinner," it was one and the same...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: I am positive now... it's the power of the Abyss, isn't it?

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: At long last, I have seen it with my own eyes...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: That is no business of yours!

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: A sinner... Yes, salvation for a sinner can only come from a sinner...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: Caribert did not deserve his fate, but now... It's wonderful — he will be able to weave his own destiny anew.

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: Born into abject sorrow, he shall now become...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: ..."The Loom of Fate."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (There's that term again... the "Loom of Fate"...)

choices.text: You're right about this being from the Abyss...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: ...Sinister? ...Dangerous?

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: I never imagined that you, of all people, would deny the Abyss... How ridiculous!

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: We once believed that you would bring new strength and hope to Khaenri'ah.

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: To us, you were the Abyss... A wondrous mystery far beyond our imagination and comprehension...

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: ...And the one who controls the Abyss can control everything!

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: We yearned for that future. We looked to you to take us there.

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: But what did you bring us instead?

response.speaker: Chlothar
response.text: #O {M#Princess}{F#Prince}... of Khaenri'ah?

choices.text: But the Abyss is sinister and dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...You're awake! Oh, thank goodness, you're awake!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon was worried sick! ...Uh, {NICKNAME}? {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: What happened while you were unconscious?

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: I checked the Ley Lines nearby. It appears that the Abyss tampered with them, and they've been in turmoil ever since...

dialogues.speaker: Dainsleif
dialogues.text: Information and memories flow within the Ley Lines... What did you witness?

choices.text: The founder of the Abyss Order... Alberich...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: You mean Chlothar Alberich?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: After founding the Abyss Order, his faith in the Abyss led him to do a great many things.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: But the curse of immortality continued to torment his body and mind, and in the end, neither his faith nor the Abyss he worshiped could save him.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: After a hundred years, he lost his mind completely, and was never seen again.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Yet his dark legacy lived on... The Defiled Statue that we encountered previously was just one perverse product of his use of Abyssal power during his life.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #You could say that. {M#She}{F#He} wouldn't be the Abyss Order's {M#Princess}{F#Prince} otherwise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you alright? You have a troubled look on your face... What happened?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I... have a story to tell you.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Your words send Dainsleif deep into thought...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #So, you saw {M#her}{F#his} memories from centuries ago... through your own eyes. It all but defies belief.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Still, as I'd suspected, the notion of the "Loom of Fate" did indeed rear its head during that time...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: And it seems closely connected to Chlothar Alberich's son, Caribert, and what happened to him...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: #And yet your {M#sister}{F#brother} never breathed a word of this incident to me... I wonder, was that the moment that {M#she}{F#he} decided to go down this path...?

choices.text: I also wish that I could know...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But one thing is clear:

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Indeed. Clearly, this series of events sparked a long period of deep contemplation. This... was where it all began.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: What is it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I need to know what lies buried in this field.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The field? What does that have to do with anything...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: ...You mean, here? Well, let's start digging and see.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After some time, you and Dainsleif discover what is buried in the field...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...You scared the dook outta Paimon. D—Did you re-bury them yet?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're done. You can open your eyes now.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: A male and female skeleton, buried together...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Interestingly, the male skeleton appears to have been interred much later... and it's holding a silk scarf in its hand.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: But what does this mean? And how did you know that there were bodies buried here?

choices.text: I think that the bones of the man...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: What? That's impossible...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Unless... Chlothar Alberich finally found a way to rid himself of the curse.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Perhaps he did...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: This all raises far too many questions... I need time to think. And to search my memories for some missing pieces...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: We should part ways here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You're just gonna leave? Why? You could come with us, y'know.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: It's better that we split up for now... I think that "he" might have seen you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who's "he"?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Yes. I have my suspicions as to his identity, but I need to confirm some other details before I can be sure.

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: If the time is right, I will tell you when we next meet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But what do you mean that he "saw" {NICKNAME}? How is that possible?

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: I fear that while these things would limit anyone else... they are no obstacle to him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Why? ...What IS he?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A "Sinner"...

response.speaker: Dainsleif
response.text: Alright, let's leave it there. Get some rest... Goodbye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There goes Dain. And just like that, it's back to being the two of us again, huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, Paimon... one more thing:

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm? What is it?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...I missed you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

choices.text: It all happened hundreds of years in the past...
The voice that I heard inside my head?
There's something I need to check.

dialogues.speaker: Caribert
dialogues.text: Do you live in the fairytale world as well? My name's Caribert, nice to meet you...

dialogues.speaker: Forest Ranger
dialogues.text: Don't go thinking this is over! Our superiors are gonna hear of this when we get back to Gandharva Ville!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That could well have been Caribert!

dialogues.speaker: Eide
dialogues.text: Caribert...! Caribert...! Where are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eide's out of control. I have to end this fight...
